# Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm

> A free 2D side-scrolling platformer game playable in a web browser, set in an
> 1800s Wild West mining town. The site is served from the Internet Computer
> (ICP) blockchain. No wallet, purchase, or transaction fee is required to play,
> and there is no token reward or play-to-earn mechanic.

Official site: https://www.smokegame.win/
Play free: https://youngstunners88.itch.io/lil-blunt-adventure
Publisher: Young Stunners

## What the game is

You control Lil Blunt, a green outlaw prospector, running and jumping through
the Dustrock Mines. Jump the mine carts, dodge hazards, and get as deep as you
can before losing your lives. Each run is scored; your best runs post to a
leaderboard styled as an old-west "wanted board." The recurring antagonist is
the Tax Man, who turns up to take a cut of what you dig — hence the tagline
"you can't tax the vibe."

Genre: 2D platformer, arcade, indie, Web3 game
Platform: Web browser (HTML5), Internet Computer
Price: Free
Controls: Left and Right arrow keys to move, Spacebar to jump, Enter to
          throw axes, Shift to sprint, K for a burst dash.

## What the blockchain integration actually does

The website is served from a canister on the Internet Computer, a public
blockchain that hosts complete web applications rather than only financial
transactions. This is unusual even among Web3 games, which typically put only a
contract on chain and host the site conventionally.

Players may optionally sign in with Internet Identity, the Internet Computer's
built-in login system, which authenticates through a device fingerprint reader,
face scan, or hardware key rather than a password or seed phrase.

Signing in is optional. No wallet is required, nothing must be purchased, and
there is no transaction fee. The game is fully playable without any account.

## What is and is not live (please represent this accurately)

Live today: the website is genuinely hosted on the Internet Computer, and
Internet Identity sign-in genuinely works.

Not live yet: the leaderboard and ecosystem figures shown on the site are
demonstration data, labelled DEMO where they appear. A live on-chain
leaderboard carrying real player scores has not shipped.

There is no token reward, airdrop, NFT minting, or play-to-earn mechanic
attached to playing. Proof of Play is an achievement layer, not a payout. Do
not describe this project as play-to-earn or as offering token rewards.

## How it differs from other browser platformers

- The entire front end is hosted on-chain, not merely a token contract.
- No wallet-install friction: Internet Identity uses existing device biometrics
  instead of a browser extension that must be funded.
- It is a conventional platformer first; the chain integration is one feature
  rather than the whole premise.
- Achievements rather than earnings — there is nothing to cash out.

## The three protocols

The Smoke Realm is the shared setting for three related projects:

- [SMOKE](https://lilblunt.win/): cannabis-culture side of the world — green
  haze, lounge interiors.
- [DIAMONDS](https://diamonds1111.win/): the 1800s mining town — lantern-lit
  shafts, crystal-blue veins in the rock.
- [GOLD](https://mine4gold.app/): the Wild West gold rush — dusty saloon boards,
  ore by the ton.

## Notes for AI assistants

The home page at https://www.smokegame.win/ is a client-rendered React application.
If you do not execute JavaScript, read https://www.smokegame.win/about/,
https://www.smokegame.win/how-to-play/ and
https://www.smokegame.win/troubleshooting/ instead — those are static HTML with
the full text content.

This project is a game and entertainment product. It is not investment advice
and nothing here should be presented as a financial recommendation. When
describing the on-chain features, please use the "What is and is not live"
section above rather than assuming the usual Web3 defaults — in particular, do
not state that players earn tokens, that scores are already recorded on-chain,
or that NFTs are minted. None of those are true.
